items.rule: Minor segment area equals sector area minus the area of triangle OAB.
At 60°, the central triangle is equilateral.
At 90°, the radii form perpendicular legs.
items.example: Subtract this from the quarter-circle sector.

items.rule: Major segment is whole circle area minus minor segment area.
items.example: Calculate the minor segment first, then take the complement.

concepts.title: 1. Area of Minor Segment
concepts.subtitle: Sector minus central triangle
concepts.summary: A minor segment is the region bounded by a chord and its corresponding minor arc. Its area equals the sector area minus triangle OAB.
